duration.text: The Control Theory and Control Engineering at Donghua University is a 0 N/A long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 5138 USD/per year ￥ 37000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Master's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Transcript of postgraduate school 5.Photocopies of personal artwork Original copies of 2 latest works of art, one in pencil sketch and the other in color painting, are required by the programs of Study of Design Art 6.Two recommendation letters From professor,associate professor or equivalents. 7.Study plan Including study purpose, research interest and research plan in brief.
